sources.title: Manage products in your Merchant Center account
sources.paraphrase: For feed-managed products, Google directs removal from the source file followed by resubmission. Its24-48hour visibility note applies after removal from Merchant Center; it does not prove this AU source-list count will converge on that schedule.

sources.title: Remove product data from Merchant Center
sources.paraphrase: Manual archive persists across uploads and can only be manually restored in the interface; it is not equivalent to correcting a source file.

decision: The completed reviewed file replacement is consistent with the documented feed approach. Retain the exact observed20present/4761count gap and same-owner follow-up. Do not infer a cause, deadline or removal from documentation and do not introduce archival, product deletion, source deletion or another upload.
